name: Rajasthan
title: Rajasthan Group Trip: Jaipur, Jaisalmer & Jodhpur (6 Days)
description: A ground-tested 6-day Jaipur, Jaisalmer and Jodhpur group trip: IRCTC-checked train legs, real closing times and the one day we had to re-sequence. Plan it for your group from Pune.
h1: Jaipur, Jaisalmer & Jodhpur: a group trip where every hour fits real opening times
intro: This is the Rajasthan plan we designed and travelled with 14 friends (24–29 October), checked against live IRCTC availability and current operating hours. We publish it with its hard deadlines and the one afternoon we had to fix, because that is what a plan is worth.

image.alt: Cover page of the Rajasthan plan we designed: Mumbai to Jaipur, Jaisalmer, Jodhpur and back to Pune, 24 to 29 October, 10 people, 2 Tempo Travellers, 5 nights, 3 train legs
image.cap: A page from the real plan

items: Assemble at Mumbai Central with luggage.
Board train 12955 (Mumbai Central–Jaipur SF Express). Sleep on the train.
Arrive Jaipur Jn. A midday arrival buys more daylight. Check in, lunch.
Amer Fort: courtyards and the Sheesh Mahal.
Hawa Mahal with its facade lit up. An exterior photo stop, no entry needed.
Street-food crawl (pyaaz kachori at Rawat Mishtan Bhandar), then a rooftop dinner in C-Scheme.

days.t: Pink City by day, desert train by night
items: City Palace and Jantar Mantar.
Nahargarh Fort, with lunch and a skyline view at Padao inside the fort.
Leave for Jaipur Jn with luggage. The road down the hill plus city traffic means you leave with margin.
Board train 12468 (Leelan SF Express) to Jaisalmer. Sleep on the train.

days.t: Jaisalmer: living fort, ghost village, dunes
items: Arrive Jaisalmer. A second, separate 12-seater AC Tempo Traveller meets the group.
Check in, freshen up, breakfast.
Jaisalmer Fort ramparts and Patwon ki Haveli.
Drive to the desert, stopping at Kuldhara, the abandoned village.
Check in at a Sam Sand Dunes desert camp.
4x4 dune bashing and quad biking at sunset.
Folk music, campfire dinner and stargazing.
Breakfast and camp checkout. We start early to protect the afternoon.
Depart for Jodhpur via NH125: a real 280–285 km, 4.5 to 6 hours. Treat 14:30 as the earliest realistic arrival, not a promise.
Flying Fox zip-line at Mehrangarh Fort. Book the earliest slot as soon as the arrival time firms up.
Jaswant Thada, a quick visit right after the zip-line.
Dinner at Stepwell Square (Toorji Ka Jhalra).
Drop at Jodhpur Jn with a real buffer.
Board train 20495 to Pune.
Arrive Pune Jn after an 18h40 journey. Whoever is collecting the group should go to Pune Jn.

deadlines: Flying Fox at Mehrangarh runs 09:30–17:00 only. The tour takes 90–120 minutes and a slot holds at most 12 people, so a group of 14 has to split. It is the one appointment on the trip that cannot move.
Road to Jodhpur: after an 08:30 start from Sam, do not plan on arriving before 14:30.
fixed_title: What we fixed in the original plan
fixed: The first draft of Day 5 did not fit real operating hours: the zip-line runs only 09:30–17:00 and Jaswant Thada closes between 17:00 and 18:00. We re-sequenced it: zip-line first, the moment the group lands in Jodhpur, then Jaswant Thada as a quick stop, both inside real hours, with the 22:00 train leaving a genuine buffer instead of a squeeze. This is the kind of catch we make for every plan.
book: Train 12955 for the whole group: AC 3 Tier availability drops week over week.
Train 12468 and the Sam Dunes camp: October to February is peak season.
The Flying Fox slot, as soon as your Jodhpur arrival time is clear.
faq: Can we start from Pune instead of Mumbai?

Yes. The on-ground days stay the same and we re-plan the first and last legs. The Pune to Jaipur train 12939 runs only on Wednesdays and Sundays and does not run on Fridays, so your start date matters.
The overnight train from Jaipur to Jaisalmer breaks vehicle continuity. One vehicle serves the Jaipur days, and a separate 12-seater AC Tempo Traveller covers Jaisalmer and Jodhpur.
Why isn't the Jodhpur arrival time guaranteed?
The desert highway from Sam to Jodhpur is 280–285 km and takes 4.5 to 6 hours. We plan from the realistic worst case and put the one fixed appointment, the zip-line, after it.
Does the route work for a group that is not 10 people?
The day structure works for groups of roughly 8 to 16. Vehicles, rooms and the zip-line slot split change with group size, and your quote shows the per-person split before you commit.

name: Kerala
title: Kerala Group Trip: Munnar, Thekkady & Alleppey (3 Days)
description: A ground-tested 3-day Kerala group trip: Munnar, Kolukkumalai jeeps, Thekkady and Alleppey, with real timings and monsoon notes. Plan it for your group from Pune.
h1: Kerala in 3 days: Munnar, Thekkady and Alleppey, planned to survive the monsoon
intro: This is the Kerala plan we designed for a group of 11 (12–14 June, monsoon season): about 557 km by 12-seater AC Tempo Traveller between a 03:30 landing and a 23:04 flight home. We publish the deadlines that cannot slip and what to watch for in the rain.

image.alt: Coconut palms along a river bank under heavy monsoon clouds, with two birds in flight

days.t: Kochi Airport to Munnar: waterfalls, tea and the hills
items: Land at Kochi. The driver meets you at arrivals with a name board; 45 minutes to freshen up.
Depart for Munnar (130 km, about 4 hours with stops). Everyone sleeps in the Tempo Traveller.
Breakfast at a highway dhaba in Kothamangalam: puttu and kadala curry, idiyappam and egg curry, hot chai.
Cheeyappara Waterfalls on NH85 (30 minutes, free). Slippery rocks: stay away from the edge.
Reach Munnar and check in at Sea Grace Cottage; rest an hour.
Attukad Waterfalls, 9 km from town on a narrow road. The Tempo Traveller parks at the base; it is a 5-minute walk, so wear grip shoes.
Lunch at a local restaurant in Munnar town: Kerala biryani, kappa and meen curry.
Tea Museum (KDHP), about 45 minutes. Open 09:00–17:00.
Mattupetty Dam and a boat on the lake (group boat, 20-seater).
Echo Point.
Top Station viewpoint, a 1 km walk from parking (cash only).
Munnar town street food and spice shopping: parotta and beef fry, pazham pori, cardamom chai.
Back at the cottage; bonfire if the owner can arrange it. Sleep by 22:00 for a 05:30 start, and ask tonight for 2 jeeps for Kolukkumalai at 06:30.
Wake up and a quick breakfast: appam and stew or puttu.
Drive to the Suryanelli base (35 km, about 1 hour).
Kolukkumalai tea estate jeep safari, about 2 hours. The Tempo Traveller cannot go up, so the group transfers to 2 pre-arranged jeeps.
Back at the base, check out and drive to Thekkady via NH85 (91 km, about 3 hours in the monsoon).
Lunch in Kumily: parotta with chicken or fish curry, then check in at Ferndale Homestay. Avoid the tourist restaurants near the Periyar gate: they are overpriced.
Sathram jeep safari near the Periyar Tiger Reserve border, about 3 hours (2 jeeps). Wildlife is not guaranteed: about a 40% chance of elephants, bison and deer.
Kalaripayattu show at Kadathanadan Kalari Centre, Kumily, about 2 hours. Pre-book it for the group.
Dinner in Kumily: prawn curry and appam, fish pollichathu.
Back at the homestay.

days.t: Thekkady to Alleppey, then the late flight home
items: Breakfast near the homestay and checkout.
Depart for Alleppey via Changanassery (138 km, about 3.5 hours): the road drops from the hills to paddy fields and backwaters.
Alleppey Beach (45 minutes) and its 150-year-old iron pier. No swimming in the monsoon: the waves are rough and dangerous.
Alappuzha Lighthouse (45 minutes, 5 floors to climb). Open Tuesday to Sunday 09:00–17:30; cash only.
Kumarakom Bird Sanctuary and a boat ride on Vembanad Lake, 1.5 hours. June to August is breeding season for resident birds; migratory birds come only November to February.
Lunch and a rest at Asado Cafe or Cafe Catamaran in Alleppey: karimeen pollichathu, filter coffee, banana pancakes.
Depart Alleppey for Kochi Airport (83 km, about 2 hours with buffer). No slack: this one is without fail.
Reach the airport, 6.5 hours before the flight: dinner, charge phones, duty-free for Kerala tea, banana chips and spices.
Check-in and security; be at the gate by 22:30.
Flight to Pune, landing about 01:00–01:15 the next morning.

deadlines: Leave Alleppey by 16:30 without fail. It is 83 km to the airport, Sunday traffic is slow and the flight is at 23:04. Be at the airport by 18:30.
Tea Museum (KDHP) is open 09:00–17:00, so it must be done before 17:00.
Top Station viewpoint is open 05:00–20:00 and takes cash only.
Alappuzha Lighthouse is open Tuesday to Sunday 09:00–17:30 (Sunday is open) and takes cash only.
Kolukkumalai is a jeep trail only. A Tempo Traveller cannot go up, and jeeps may cancel in extreme heavy rain. Backup viewpoints near Munnar: Lockhart Gap or Pothamedu.
Kalaripayattu show: the 18:00 slot must be booked in advance.
Alleppey Beach in the monsoon: no swimming.
If a spot closes for heavy rain or a landslide alert, tell the group leader at once and use the backup viewpoints.

book: Web check-in on the morning of Day 3, 24 hours before the flight. At the airport: baggage drop, security, and at the gate by 22:30.
The Kalaripayattu show (18:00 slot) for the whole group.
Two jeeps for Kolukkumalai at 06:30: ask the Munnar owner the night before, and call to confirm the early check-in at 09:30.
Flights. Our plan does not fix flight numbers, so compare fares for your dates.
faq: Why land at 03:30 and drive straight to Munnar?
It turns the flight into the first leg of the trip. After 45 minutes to freshen up, the group sleeps in the Tempo Traveller on the 4-hour drive and reaches Munnar by 09:30 with the whole day ahead.
Can we reach Kolukkumalai in the Tempo Traveller?
No. It is a jeep trail only, so the group transfers to 2 jeeps at the Suryanelli base. They may cancel in extreme heavy rain; Lockhart Gap and Pothamedu are the backup viewpoints.
Does this plan work in the monsoon?

It was designed in one. The drive from Munnar to Thekkady takes about 3 hours in the monsoon, there is no swimming at Alleppey Beach, and Kolukkumalai jeeps may cancel in heavy rain. If a spot closes for rain or a landslide alert, the group leader switches to the backup viewpoints.
It is 83 km to Kochi Airport, Sunday traffic is slow and the flight leaves at 23:04. Leaving at 16:30 puts you at the airport by 18:30 with time for dinner and check-in.
How big a group does it suit?

We tested it with 11 people in one 12-seater Tempo Traveller and 2 jeeps at each jeep stop. Vehicles, rooms and jeeps change with group size, and your quote shows the per-person split before you commit.
